title: MetaVia Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: MetaVia Inc. filed an 8-K current report announcing that the first patient was dosed in Part 3 of its Phase 1 clinical trial evaluating DA-1726, a novel dual oxyntomodulin analog targeting GLP-1 and glucagon receptors. Part 3 consists of two 16-week titration cohorts designed to evaluate one-step and two-step dose-escalation strategies to safely achieve higher target doses and further optimize tolerability.
key_points: MetaVia Inc. is a Delaware corporation listed on Nasdaq under symbol MTVA with principal offices in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
The company announced first patient dosing in Part 3 of its Phase 1 clinical trial for DA-1726.
DA-1726 is a novel dual oxyntomodulin (OXM) analog targeting both GLP-1 (GLP1R) and glucagon (GCGR) receptors.
Part 3 consists of two 16-week titration cohorts evaluating one-step and two-step dose-escalation strategies.
The trial aims to safely achieve higher target doses and further optimize tolerability.
